local: src/features/workspace.rs (armory_mapping_page: mapping surface without product chrome)
src/shell/armory_page/device_root.rs (device panel, iframe height by device type)
src/shell.rs (share entry opens the device panel next to the share form)
armory.rule: product has a root armory branch AND a local mapping page (adapter Customize tab or a source TAB_CUSTOMIZE page in a family renderer)
armory.boundary: the panel message handshake is recorded but not exchanged (both sides run in this process); audio/accessory families and products without a local mapping page keep the entry closed

local: src/shell/chroma_page.rs (.box-item-device card opens the popup without a gate when a lighting page exists)
chromaApp.rule: product has a root chromaApp branch AND a local lighting page (adapter tab set or a source TAB_LIGHTING page in a family renderer)
chromaApp.boundary: audio/accessory families and products without a local lighting page keep the explicit unavailable state

macro.rule: the product-side macro branch only appears inside the macro application iframe, so the same page is opened there
macro.boundary: macro service, recording and device binding remain unconnected

multiDevicePairing.rule: Dashboard device box opens the named `multi-device-pairing*` window
multiDevicePairing.boundary: keep as the audited second-window exception; device services stay unconnected
